name: context-menu-16
description: A spreadsheet grid whose cell menu inserts rows, sorts, and formats the clicked cell.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ArrowUpDownIcon, CopyIcon, ScissorsIcon } from "lucide-react" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuSub, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const rows = [ ["Region", "Q3", "Q4"], ["North", "$42k", "$51k"], ["South", "$38k", "$36k"], ["West", "$57k", "$64k"], ] export default function SpreadsheetCellMenu() { const [active, setActive] = React.useState("B2") return (
{active}
{rows.map((row, r) => row.map((cell, c) => { const ref = String.fromCharCode(65 + c) + (r + 1) return ( setActive(ref)} className={cn( "border-e border-b px-2 py-1.5", r === 0 && "bg-muted/60 font-medium", active === ref && "outline-2 -outline-offset-2 outline-primary" )} > {cell} Cell {ref} Cut ⌘X Copy ⌘C Insert row above Insert row below Insert column left Sort column A → Z Z → A Delete row {r + 1} ) }) )}
) }
